corpusAttribution: HKUST CAiRE; Lovenia et al., ASCEND (LREC 2022)
corpusSelection: First 30 rows per language with duration >= 2 seconds; round-robin across first up to three numeric speaker IDs in test split, preserving source row order per speaker; exhausted speakers skipped; chosen before inference
normalization: Same NFKC/Han-CER/Latin-WER rules as evaluate_transcription.py; no script conversion

settings.modelLifetime: Reload for each clip; load and inference measured separately

scope: Desktop research, not mobile integration, distribution clearance, representative accuracy or phone performance.
